name: one-leg-hack-squat.html
instructions:
1. Adjust the hack squat machine and load an appropriate weight.
2. Place one foot on the platform, centered, with the heel slightly raised.
3. Place your shoulders under the pads and grip the handles.
4. Release the safety bars to allow the machine to move. This is the starting position.
5. Slowly bend your knee, lowering your body while keeping your torso upright.
6. Press through your heel to extend your leg and return to the starting position. This is one rep.
7. Complete the desired reps, then switch legs.
